name: Puck's Seamlessifier + Ripper
summary: Desktop tool that rips textures out of photos in any perspective and turns them into seamless tileable images.
description: A downloadable Windows, macOS and Linux tool that extracts textures from photos with polygon selections and perspective correction, then generates seamless tileable versions and packs them into texture atlases exported as PNG.
contains: downloads for Windows, macOS and Linux
polygon-based texture extraction with perspective correction
seamless methods: Smoothed Collage and Scattered Edges
exports selected textures or the whole atlas as PNG
